def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        v=grid[r][c]
        if not v or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            q=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==v:
              seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
        objs.append((v,cells))
    # Objects slide right, starting with the rightmost, until blocked by another object or edge.
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:max(c for r,c in o[1]), reverse=True)
    occupied=set(); placed=[]
    for v,cells in objs:
      shift=0
      while all(c+shift+1<w and (r,c+shift+1) not in occupied for r,c in cells): shift+=1
      moved=[(r,c+shift) for r,c in cells]
      occupied.update(moved); placed.append((v,moved))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for v,cells in placed:
      for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=v
    return out
PY
